x: This year was the first time we had had representatives (Rosemary Honeychurch, Vicky Mitchell and Jenny Webb) in the Southern Inter Counties and National Inter Counties Cross Country Championships.
For the first time ever we gained a Team Medal in these Championships and good runs from Jenny Webb (Inter) and Rosemary Honeychurch (Seniors) who gained County Vests.
Two Club Records fell - Cindy James in the Junior Discus and Jenny Webb knocking nearly a minute off the previous Intermediate 3000m record.
Opposite Page: Jenny Webb has made a big impact on our middle distance events and has broken the Club Inters 1500m record with 4:52.6.
